name: Show More for Elementor – SEO Friendly
author: Saeed Amini

sections.description:
Show More for Elementor – SEO Friendly is a simple and functional widget for Elementor that allows you to hide a portion of text and display it with the click of a button.
Features:

  • Fully SEO friendly (hidden content is readable by Google)
  • No display:none or visibility:hidden
  • Real slide animation
  • Lightweight, fast and without additional dependencies
  • Compatible with all themes
  • Translatable
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu
  3. Open Elementor editor
  4. Search for Show More (SEO Friendly) widget
  5. Drag & drop into your page
sections.faq:
Is this widget SEO safe?

Yes. The content is in the DOM and is only hidden by max-height.

Does it work with the free version of Elementor?

Yes.
